goal: Perform a periodic whole-search UX audit across key mobile/tablet/desktop states without turning the audit itself into a permanent blocking CI matrix.
invariants: audit itself produces evidence, not opportunistic code changes
confirmed defects become separate scoped tasks with their own owns_paths and risk
desktop and mobile are always represented; intermediate widths are added only when layout risk justifies them
full-site or five-width visual regression remains periodic/on-demand rather than a gate for every small change
done_when: audit records PASS, a concrete DEFECT task, or BLOCKED_EXTERNAL
observation-only audit creates no product-code diff and requires no CI
a confirmed defect is split into its own task contract with exact owns_paths and risk-scoped verification
broad five-width or full-site regression remains on-demand maintenance evidence rather than a normal development gate
